## Summary

**Rollback:** checkout-api's latest deploy (v2.3.1) was failing health checks in production with an 18% error rate. Per deployment history, v2.3.0 was the most recent release healthy in production, so I rolled back all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0. The first rollback attempt partially failed after us-east due to an orchestrator error; a retry completed the rollout.

**Verification:** All three regions are now running v2.3.0, the service is healthy, and the error rate has dropped from 18% to 0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0001) for checkout-api documenting the failed deploy, the rollback steps (including the partial-failure retry), and post-rollback status.

No change-manager approval was required since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production. Suggested next step for the team: investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before re-releasing.
